<b>Leaf Gliders</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are light winged flyers that live in flocks in [[Verdania]].<ref>Leaf Glider Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Fine winged flyer that survives in flocks. So light they can rest atop still water's surface."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Leaf Gliders are completely harmless, and fly away if Hornet gets in their vicinity or plays the Needolin. This alerts any other nearby Leaf Gliders to fly away as well.

== Location ==
Leaf Gliders can be found in [[Lost Verdania]].
